name: Thunderhorn Water Well
summary: At Thunderhorn Water Well, tauren and herds draw water in central Mulgore. The well lies along the path between Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff. The valley’s wells sustain life across the grasslands, and the tauren must keep them clean and defended.

sections.title: A Life-Giving Spring
sections.body: Thunderhorn Water Well draws from the aquifers beneath central Mulgore. Nomadic tauren and the valley’s settled villages depend on communal wells for water and sustenance. Water is precious across the plains, and control of the wells means control of the land. The Venture Company has repeatedly sought these sources for industrial use, threatening the balance the tribes work to preserve.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderhorn Water Well located?
faq.answer: Thunderhorn Water Well lies in central Mulgore, beside the north-south road between Bloodhoof Village and the bluffs of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why is this water well important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Mulgore’s wells sustain its herds, pilgrims, and settlements with water from beneath the valley. The tauren regard water as a gift from the Earth Mother and guard it against corruption and greed.
Goblins of the Venture Company tried to seize the well and monopolize the valley’s water for their nearby mining and logging ventures. Local tauren fought back to reclaim and purify it.

angles.text: As a tauren, you depend on wells like Thunderhorn, gifts from the Earth Mother that need guarding against foreign polluters and greedy trespassers.
As a shaman, you revere Mulgore’s pure springs and protect the water spirits and subterranean currents as a sacred duty.
